fields.disappearance: Agrahāyaṇa śukla aṣṭamī (the record's text; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna)
fields.place: Baḍabeluna (Burdwan): his śrīpāṭa and the temple of Gopīnātha
fields.notes: Named in Abhirāma dāsa's Pāṭa-paryaṭana; had his śrīpāṭa at Baḍabeluna (Burdwan), where he began the service of Gopīnātha before Gaurāṅga's birth; in a dream told Rādhāvallabha Rāya to install Rādhā beside Gopīnātha. Aṇimā-siddhi (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 96-97). Land grants from the Emperor (at Mānasiṁha's request), the Rājās of Burdwan and even a dacoit chief. (The works field said «Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā»: that is only where he is named.)

fields.place: Ariṭ-grāma (7 years); Govinda-kuṇḍa (10); Pāiṭhā (5); Jatipurā (his last 6 years)
fields.notes: Disciple of Dayāla dāsa Bābājī of Vṛndāvana; did bhajana at Ariṭ-grāma, Govinda-kuṇḍa, Pāiṭhā and Jatipurā. Lived by the Sva-niyama-daśaka, kept apart as the lowest of all, looked for Kṛṣṇa's footprints in Vraja, kept pots of Vaiṣṇavas' foot-water in his dark room and left prasāda under trees (Advaita dāsa Bābājī).
